purpose: Continuous bounded research with frozen evidence and controlled activation review
current_research_problem: Recent retrospective gains disappeared under doubled modeled spread and slippage.
proposal_scope: Existing validated chromosome templates only; no arbitrary generated code or live strategy edits.
stages: separate historical base and stress screens
independent broker-cost and live-gate parity validation
insufficient_activity: Do not force entries or relax thresholds. End the frozen trial as insufficient activity at its deadline.
monitoring: Source drift, coverage gaps, invalid chronology, changed evidence or excess research drawdown quarantine the trial.
activation: Research output does not grant broker authority. Passing research screens is an input to independent validation and existing promotion review.
rollback: New research quarantine does not close positions or mutate current strategies. Existing broker-authorized strategy drawdown controls remain responsible for deployed models.
limitations: Generated-rule simulator is not full live-system parity.
Doubled hypothetical friction is a sensitivity check, not calibrated fill costs.
Data reuse and multiple candidate searches limit historical evidence.
Future trade counts and profitable qualification cannot be guaranteed.
